This misalignment causes the function to fail in detecting Bingo on the right diagonal.
Repair Directions:
1. Correct the condition for the right diagonal check from `if the sum of I and J equals N` to `if the sum of I and J equals N - 1`.
2. Ensure all other conditions and logic for marking cells and checking Bingo are correctly implemented.
